name: Proton VPN
author: Proton AG
summary: High-speed Swiss VPN that safeguards your privacy.
description:
We built ProtonVPN with extra security features to make it better at protecting your privacy than an ordinary VPN.
When you use ProtonVPN to browse the web, your Internet connection is encrypted.
By routing your connection through encrypted tunnels, ProtonVPNs advanced security features ensure that an attacker cannot eavesdrop on your connection.
It also allows you to access websites that might be blocked in your country.

versions.release_notes:
- New look, same protection. We refreshed our designs and moved some things around to make the app easier to use.
- Introducing Recents. It's now even easier to reconnect to your favorite servers. View your most recent connections on the home screen, or pin them for quick access.
- Even more powerful profiles. Add advanced profile settings like NetShield and port forwarding, or set up Connect and Go to launch a website of your choice when you connect.
- We've addressed an issue that caused the app to freeze for some users.
- Address app startup issues and performance stability, including potential high CPU usage.

- Improves connection ability on censored countries.
- Minor stability fixes.

- Stability and performance improvements.
- Improved Smart Protocol for better performance in censored countries.
- Updated to the latest version of the OpenVPN library.
